title: Kindling Kissed Uruguayan Beef Empanadas
description: Fresh, flaky, and comforting Uruguayan dish featuring ground cinnamon and rest-meat, perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Preheat the kadhai over medium-high heat, adding 2 tablespoons of olive oil to the pan
Add the diced onion to the kadhai and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic to the kadhai and cook for an additional 1 minute
Add the ground beef to the kadhai, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until browned, about 5-7 minutes
Add the ground cinnamon, sea salt, and black pepper to the kadhai, stirring to combine
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch
Spoon about 1 tablespoon of the beef mixture onto the center of each empanada dough round
Brush the edges of the empanada dough with the beaten egg for a golden glaze
Fold the empanada dough in half, pressing the edges together to seal the empanada
Add the empanadas to the kadhai, cooking for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown
